scope.title: AgDS v1.30.0 release
scope.description: Adds a responsive preview, indented Accordions fixes Checkbox vertical-alignment, updates Conditional field container style and its support for invalid fields, includes a lot of new pattern and accessibility documentation, plus various bug fixes and improvements.
